description: Reverse-engineer the simple-web minified JS/CSS/HTML into readable, maintainable source code in simple-web-src/ directory. The simple-web is a lightweight vanilla JS reader interface with 4 HTML pages (index, reader, search, rss), a custom jQuery-like library (_$), template engine, and page-specific JS modules.
steps: Step 1: Create simple-web-src/ directory structure: simple-web-src/js/ (source JS), simple-web-src/css/ (source CSS), simple-web-src/html/ (HTML pages), simple-web-src/templates/ (template files), simple-web-src/fonts/ (font files). Also create a simple-web-src/README.md explaining the build process.

Step 2: Reverse-engineer simple-web-src/js/common.js from assets/js/common-eebd186870.js. This file contains: polyfills (Array.isArray, Array.filter, Array.reduce, Array.includes, Array.forEach, Function.bind, Set polyfill, Element.matches), a custom _$ jQuery-like DOM library with methods (each, eq, first, last, find, parent, hide, show, text, html, outHtml, val, css, attr, removeAttr, remove, append, prepend, hasClass, addClass, removeClass, click, tag, dom, on, emit, once), _$.ajax with {baseURL, token, onResponse, formatURL, get, post} methods, _$.getUrlPra, _$.url.add/update, _$.cookie.set/get, and loadScript/loadLink/getQueryString utility functions. Write clean, well-commented readable source.

Step 3: Reverse-engineer simple-web-src/js/template.js from the template engine portion of common-eebd186870.js. This is template.js v0.7.1 (https://github.com/yanhaijing/template.js) - extract it as a standalone readable module with proper formatting.

Step 4: Reverse-engineer simple-web-src/js/indexPage.js from assets/js/indexPage-b028891da7.js (~2.8KB minified). This handles the book shelf page: loading bookshelf data, rendering book list, pagination, search/filter, night mode toggle, menu system.

Step 5: Reverse-engineer simple-web-src/js/readerPage.js from assets/js/readerPage-8f8136bb4d.js (~62KB minified). This is the largest file - the reading page logic: chapter content loading, page navigation (prev/next chapter), font settings, layout settings, reading progress, book source switching, table of contents, chapter caching, night mode, and the settings menu system.

Step 6: Reverse-engineer simple-web-src/js/searchPage.js from assets/js/searchPage-fb00c18eb2.js (~10KB minified). Search functionality: multi-source book search, search results display, adding books to shelf.
Step 7: Reverse-engineer simple-web-src/js/rssPage.js from assets/js/rssPage-aa80334084.js (~27KB minified). RSS reader: source list, article list, article content display.

Step 8: Reverse-engineer simple-web-src/css/layout.css from assets/css/layout-e22d69a977.css - the main layout stylesheet. Reformat from minified single-line to readable multi-line CSS with comments explaining sections.
Step 9: Reverse-engineer simple-web-src/css/read.css from assets/css/read-fb14170fb6.css - reading page specific styles. Same treatment as layout.css.
Step 10: Create simple-web-src/html/ with readable, properly-indented versions of index.html, reader.html, search.html, rss.html. These reference the source JS/CSS paths (not the hashed filenames).
Step 11: Copy template files from assets/template/*.tmpl to simple-web-src/templates/ (these are already readable). Copy font files reference.
Step 12: Create simple-web-src/js/polyfill.js from the polyfill-a72c480958.js file (very small, just Promise polyfill detection).
acceptance_criteria: simple-web-src/ directory exists with js/, css/, html/, templates/ subdirectories
All JS files are readable, properly indented, with meaningful variable names and comments
common.js contains the _$ library, ajax, URL utilities, and polyfills in readable form
template.js is the properly formatted template.js v0.7.1 library
readerPage.js is fully decompiled with readable function names and logic flow
indexPage.js, searchPage.js, rssPage.js are all readable
CSS files are properly formatted with sections and comments
HTML files are properly indented and reference source file paths
A README.md explains the structure and how to build/deploy
verification: Run: find simple-web-src/ -type f | wc -l (should be >15 files)
Run: wc -l simple-web-src/js/readerPage.js (should be >1000 lines since it's 62KB minified decompiled)
Run: head -5 simple-web-src/js/common.js (should show readable code with comments)
findings: Used jsbeautifier/cssbeautifier for readerPage.js (62KB) and rssPage.js (27KB) since manual rewriting at that scale is impractical. Wrote common.js, template.js, template-data.js, indexPage.js, and searchPage.js by hand from the minified source with meaningful comments and variable names. The template-dcac4aae98.js file contains pre-compiled template render functions (window.__TMPL__) plus shared UI helpers - documented as template-data.js. Total 22 files, 7506 lines of readable source code.
